$comment: The weapon actions a hero trained in a weapon unlocks with it while it is in the main hand (Baldur's Gate 3's 'Proficiency unlocks', from bg3.wiki's Weapon actions; src/rules/WeaponActions.ts, played by src/systems/WeaponActions.ts). Each action: its name; its icon (public/weapon-actions/<icon>_pixelart.png, scripts/download-weapon-action-icons.py); cost (action, bonus, movement, reaction: as Baldur's Gate spends it, told in the tooltip); recharge (short_rest: once until a short or long rest, the hero's own, spent even on a miss; unlimited); kind (strike: the next melee blow; shot: the next shot; cleave: the next swing sweeps wide, up to 3 foes at half damage; rush: a charge along the aim striking every foe in the path; stance: a buff for a turn, 6 s; reaction: works by itself; mobile: a shot at once while sprinting); reach (melee or ranged); damage (weapon: the weapon's own; d4_mod: 1d4 + the better of STR and DEX of the weapon's kind; d4: 1d4 bludgeoning; half_weapon; none); save, dcBonus (the weapon action DC: 8 + proficiency + the better of STR and DEX + dcBonus; hybridDc: or the spell save DC, whichever is higher) and the condition a failed save lays for turns (6 s each; src/systems/WeaponMarks.ts); text: the rule as Baldur's Gate tells it; playedAs: how the game plays it where real time asks otherwise. weapons: each weapon of src/data/weapons.json and the actions it unlocks (none listed: none).

backbreaker.name: Backbreaker
backbreaker.text: Strike the foe's back for 1d4 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier: it falls Prone unless it makes a Strength saving throw.

brace_melee.name: Brace (Melee)
brace_melee.text: Steady yourself: until the end of the turn, your melee damage dice are rolled twice and the higher total is kept.
brace_melee.playedAs: For 6 seconds (a turn) every melee blow rolls its damage twice and keeps the higher; it costs no movement.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.text: Swing in a wide arc and strike up to 3 foes before you (a 7 ft cone), each for half your weapon's damage.
cleave.playedAs: The next swing sweeps a wide arc, catching foes beside you too: up to 3 of them, each for half damage.

concussive_smash.name: Concussive Smash
concussive_smash.text: A blow to the head with the weapon's damage: the foe is Dazed unless it makes a Constitution saving throw (the better of the weapon action DC + 2 and your spell save DC).

maiming_strike.name: Maiming Strike
maiming_strike.text: Strike the foe's legs for 1d4 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier: it is Maimed, unable to move, unless it makes a Constitution saving throw.

disarming_strike.name: Disarming Strike
disarming_strike.text: Strike for 1d4 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier: the foe drops its weapon unless it makes a Strength saving throw.
disarming_strike.playedAs: A foe that drops its weapon fights barehanded for the rest of the fight.

flourish.name: Flourish
flourish.text: A dazzling feint for 1d4 bludgeoning: the foe is Off Balance unless it makes a Dexterity saving throw.

heartstopper.name: Heartstopper
heartstopper.text: A blow to the chest for 1d4 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier: the foe suffers Chest Trauma unless it makes a Constitution saving throw.

lacerate.name: Lacerate
lacerate.text: Slash the foe open with the weapon's damage: it is Bleeding unless it makes a Constitution saving throw.

piercing_strike.name: Piercing Strike
piercing_strike.text: Drive the point deep with the weapon's damage: the foe suffers Gaping Wounds unless it makes a Constitution saving throw.

pommel_strike.name: Pommel Strike
pommel_strike.text: Strike with the hilt for 1d4 bludgeoning: the foe is Dazed unless it makes a Constitution saving throw.

prepare.name: Prepare
prepare.text: Ready a mighty swing: until the end of the turn, your melee attacks deal your Strength modifier more slashing damage.
prepare.playedAs: For 6 seconds (a turn) every melee blow deals your Strength modifier more damage; it costs no movement.

rush_attack.name: Rush Attack
rush_attack.text: Charge up to 30 ft, striking every foe in your path for 1d4 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier: each is Off Balance unless it makes a Strength saving throw.

tenacity.name: Tenacity
tenacity.text: When you miss with a melee attack, you still deal your Strength modifier in bludgeoning damage (at least 1).
tenacity.playedAs: Always ready while you wield the weapon; its square switches it off and on.

topple.name: Topple
topple.text: Sweep at the foe's legs for 1d4 bludgeoning: it falls Prone unless it makes a Dexterity saving throw.

weakening_strike.name: Weakening Strike
weakening_strike.text: Bruise the foe's arms for 1d4 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier: it has a Weak Grip unless it makes a Strength saving throw.

brace_ranged.name: Brace (Ranged)
brace_ranged.text: Steady your aim: until the end of the turn, your ranged damage dice are rolled twice and the higher total is kept.
brace_ranged.playedAs: For 6 seconds (a turn) every shot rolls its damage twice and keeps the higher; it costs no movement.

hamstring_shot.name: Hamstring Shot
hamstring_shot.text: A shot at the legs with the weapon's damage: the foe is Hamstrung unless it makes a Constitution saving throw.

mobile_shot.name: Mobile Shot
mobile_shot.text: After you Dash or Disengage, make a ranged attack with this weapon as a bonus action.
mobile_shot.playedAs: While you sprint, loose a bolt at once, whether or not the weapon has reloaded.

piercing_shot.name: Piercing Shot
piercing_shot.text: A shot that tears the wound wide, with the weapon's damage: the foe suffers Gaping Wounds unless it makes a Constitution saving throw.
